title: Presales & CRM Executive for Real Estate
description:
**Job Title:** **Senior Executive – Real Estate Pre-Sales & Customer Relationship Management (CRM)**

**Department:** Sales & Marketing

**Industry:** Real Estate

**Location:** Kolkata

**Employment Type:** Full-Time

**Salary: Upto 30,000/- per month**

**Job Purpose**

The Senior Executive – Pre-Sales & Customer Relationship Management will be responsible for driving the end-to-end lead lifecycle, managing customer engagement from initial inquiry to post-sales documentation, and coordinating **digital marketing campaigns**. This role acts as a bridge between prospective homebuyers, internal sales/legal teams, and digital marketing agencies to optimize lead conversion, facilitate timely payment collections, and maintain accurate sales performance metrics.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Pre-Sales & Lead Management**

* Manage end-to-end pre-sales operations, including handling customer inquiries, lead allocation, qualification, and structured follow-ups.
* Maintain and update real estate CRM/ERP systems (e.g., Sell.do, B2B property portals) to ensure seamless tracking of lead progression through the sales funnel.
* Actively engage with prospective buyers to understand property requirements, provide detailed project information, schedule site visits, and push leads toward conversion.

**2. Customer Relationship Management & Post-Sales Support**

* Serve as the key liaison for post-sales operations, ensuring a high-touch customer experience.
* Coordinate customer payment schedules, send demand notes, and execute regular payment follow-ups to maintain healthy cash flow.
* Assist in drafting and coordinating legal documentation, including Agreements for Sale, MOUs, and other property-related paperwork.
* Address customer queries and resolve post-booking concerns promptly to maintain strong customer satisfaction and referral generation.

**3. Digital Marketing & Campaign Coordination**

* Manage online property listings across major real estate portals and maintain accurate project information.
* Plan and execute direct customer outreach campaigns via bulk Email, SMS, and WhatsApp messaging platforms.
* Analyze Google Ads performance and lead volume, assisting with campaign budget coordination and lead attribution tracking.
* Collaborate with external creative and digital marketing agencies to deliver project collateral, ad creatives, and marketing content.

**4. Sales MIS & Reporting**

* Prepare, maintain, and analyze regular Sales MIS reports to evaluate lead conversion rates, campaign effectiveness, and overall sales team performance.
* Track and present lead pipeline metrics to senior leadership during review meetings.

**Key Requirements & Qualifications**

* **Experience:** 3-4 years of hands-on experience in Real Estate Pre-Sales, Customer Relationship Management (CRM), and Sales Coordination.
* **Education:** Any Graduate
* **Technical Skills:**
* **Proficient in real estate CRM/ERP platforms (e.g., Sell.do, property portals).**
* Functional understanding of Google Ads analytics, budget coordination, and lead management.
* Experience with bulk messaging software (Email, SMS, WhatsApp marketing tools).
* Advanced knowledge of Microsoft Excel for MIS reporting and tracking.
* **Core Competencies:**
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills (Bengali, English, and Hindi).
* Customer-centric approach with strong negotiation and problem-solving abilities.
* Strong organizational and multi-tasking skills with a keen eye for detail.

Pay: ₹25,000.00 - ₹30,000.00 per month

Benefits:

* Cell phone reimbursement
* Internet reimbursement
* Paid sick time

Application Question(s):

* How many years of similar experience you have?
* Are you working in Real Estate Industry?

Work Location: In person

title: Presales Executive
description:
***About the Role***

We're looking for a Presales Executive to join our Sales, Marketing and Customer Service team at our Head Office in Kolkata. You'll be the first point of contact for potential homebuyers interested in DTC Projects' residential complexes \- the bridge between interested prospects and their future homes.

***What You'll Do***

\- Proactively call and engage new leads, and nurture existing ones in the database

\- Maintain accurate, real\-time updates of lead status and interactions in Salesforce CRM

\- Develop and execute follow\-up strategies to move prospects through the sales funnel

\- Generate weekly reports on lead activity, conversion metrics, and pipeline status

\- Coordinate site visits and walkthroughs for interested prospects

\- Gather and document customer requirements and feedback to support the sales team

***What We're Looking For***

\- 1\-2 years of hands\-on experience in telesales or real estate pre\-sales

\- Fluent communication skills in English, Hindi, and Bengali (speaking, reading, and writing)

\- Bachelor's degree in any discipline

\- Comfortable using CRM systems \- Salesforce experience is a plus

\- Strong computer literacy and ability to learn new tools quickly

\- Self\-motivated with excellent follow\-up and organisational skills

***What We Offer***

\- Full statutory benefits as a permanent employee

\- Health insurance and mediclaim coverage

\- EPFO contributions (where applicable)

\- Annual performance management and appraisal

\- Yearly leave encashment

\- Annual performance bonus

***How to Apply***

Send your CV to hr@dtcgroup.in with the subject line: Application \- Presales Executive

Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.

Pay: ₹10,013\.20 \- ₹21,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Cell phone reimbursement
* Health insurance
* Paid sick time
* Provident Fund

Work Location: In person
